lines.en: I plod slowly along the waterside.
Each step of mine covers very little.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的烂泥里趟过去。
lines.en: I wade through the swamp's muck.
I walk along a jungle stream.
I walk steadily, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 草叶在我肚子下面扫过。
lines.en: Grass sweeps under my belly.

lines.zh: 我的短腿在泥里一沉一浮。
lines.en: My short legs sink and rise in the mud.
I walk toward the sound of water.
I chew grass as I walk.
I sway my broad hindquarters forward.
I slowly go around a fallen tree.

lines.zh: 我走进浅水里，凉快多了。
lines.en: I step into the shallows. Much cooler.
I soak in the water with only my head out.
I squint and bask in the sun.
Rings spread on the water.
My nose twitches slowly.
I chew very slowly.

lines.zh: 几只小鸟在我背上落下。
lines.en: A few small birds land on my back.
I do not shoo them away.
The swamp is stiflingly hot.
I rest my chin on the muddy bank.
I blink slowly.
I wait for the sun to move west.
Water slides off my coat.
I hear monkeys calling far off.

lines.zh: 我趴着，像块温热的石头。
lines.en: I lie still like a warm stone.
I flap my ears.

lines.zh: 给我西瓜片，我帮你削木头。
lines.en: Give me melon slices and I'll strip your logs.
The cool of the water is just right.
My eyes are shut. It is very pleasant.
What do you want? I cannot be bothered to move.
Is that watermelon in your hand?
I am soaking here. Very busy.
Sit if you like, but do not crowd me.
I come to this waterside often.

lines.zh: 你要是给我原木，我能帮你。
lines.en: Bring me a log and I can help.
My teeth can strip bark.
I do not like being hurried.

lines.zh: 你站得挡住我的太阳了。
lines.en: You are blocking my sun.
Take your time. Nothing here is urgent.
You may touch me. I will not move.
I am quite docile. Do not misunderstand.
I move away slowly.
There is a new cut on me.
I grunt once and sink into the mud.
I retreat two steps into the water.
I am not much for fighting back.
Blood drips onto the mud.
I twitch my hide.
I am breathing heavily.
I sink into the water and the wound cools.
I can still walk slowly.
Watermelon? I like that.
Put it in the water and I will come.
Watermelon slice? I shuffle over.
That mouthful is a good size.
The capybara soaks and chews slowly.
Do not reach over and grab it.
After eating I want to soak again.
This piece is sweet.
Where watermelon is concerned, I am never polite.
One more piece. Just one.
You bump into me. I do not move.
I am still dripping.
A splash goes up from the muddy water.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我还在原地。
lines.en: You stepped back twice; I have not moved.
I slowly turn my body aside.
That was nothing. My hide is thick.
My short legs nearly slipped.
We are squeezed on one muddy path.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，水甩你一身。
lines.en: I shake my head and water flies on you.
Move aside; I am going into the water.
Let us soak in the water together.
Lean on me. No need to be polite.
We walk slowly, all day.
There is grass enough by the water.
I saved you half the watermelon.

lines.zh: 你别急着说话，先泡一会儿。
lines.en: Do not rush to talk. Soak a while first.

lines.zh: 我们两个挤在泥里正好。
lines.en: The two of us fit in the mud nicely.
With you here, more birds land.
Same waterside tomorrow.
I am slow. Match my pace.

lines.zh: 西瓜片放进嘴里，慢慢来。
lines.en: A melon slice in my mouth — easy now.
Not light. I will drag it.
I press it into the mud.
I chew twice. It is not grass.
It rolled into the water.
I nudge it with my snout.
Could this be worked on?
I slowly push it onto the bank.
Too heavy. I will sit and look at it.
I will leave it until you want it.
Something moved over there. I am not going.
I keep my eyes on my grass.
You are blocking my water.
I shift away a little.
I do not fight anyone. I only soak.
Step back and I will go on eating.
The waterside is my place.
When I move, the mud sounds.
I'm not scared, just unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 你要是一直站那儿，我就换个地方。
lines.en: If you keep standing there, I will move elsewhere.
I turn my head slowly to you.

lines.zh: 你还在，我就再等一会儿。
lines.en: You are still there; I will wait a little longer.

lines.zh: 我把身子往水里沉了沉。
lines.en: I sink a little deeper into the water.
Only my eyes remain above the water.
Your shadow falls beside me.
I do not move, and neither do you.
I count how long you have stood there.

lines.zh: 西瓜片一递，我就跟到底。
lines.en: One melon slice and I follow you anywhere.
There are footprints on the muddy bank.
I just soak here and watch you.
I butted you. Not hard.
My teeth catch your sleeve.
I let go almost at once.
I shake my head and splash your face.
I butt you once and back away.
I barely put any force into that.
I have squeezed you into the muddy water.
I slipped a little myself.
You pushed, and I moved half a step.
I have gone back into the water.
I rise slowly by the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽里多了一只大水豚。
lines.en: There is one more big capybara in the swamp.
I soaked in the water for a while first.
The jungle stream is cool.
Melon slice at my lips. One moment.
I walk slowly into the grass.
The grass here is tender.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步，没在意。
lines.en: I heard your steps and paid them no mind.
I stand two steps from the water.
I surface from the swamp.

lines.zh: 沼泽的热气贴在我身上。
lines.en: The swamp's heat clings to me.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，又低头吃草。
lines.en: I glance at you and go back to grazing.

lines.zh: 火燎掉了我背上一撮毛。
lines.en: The fire singed a patch of my fur.
I rolled off the bank into the mud.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I kick upward.
Muddy water flies everywhere.
My thick hide stops the arrow.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: A chill works into my bones.
The grass on the bank has all been eaten.

lines.zh: 雷打在水边，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes by the water and I shudder.
I sink and cannot reach the muddy bottom.
